passage:
**Enrollment at a public high school by grade level, school year 2025–2026** (number of students)

| Grade level | Students |
| --- | ---: |
| Grade 7 | 300 |
| Grade 8 | 275 |
| Grade 9 | 250 |
| Grade 10 | 175 |
| Total | 1,000 |
stem: How many more students are in Grade 7 than in Grade 10?
hints: "How many more" means find the difference.
Find the Grade 7 row and the Grade 10 row.
Subtract the smaller number from the bigger number.

solution.methodName: Find the values, then add or subtract

steps.action: Grade 7 has 125 more students than Grade 10.

trapNotes.25: This subtracts Grade 8 (300 − 275). Check that you used the Grade 10 row.
trapNotes.50: This subtracts Grade 9 (300 − 250). Check that you used the Grade 10 row.
trapNotes.475: This adds the two grades (300 + 175). "How many more" means subtract.
